title: Puharich first announces his Geller work at Zellerbach Auditorium

tellings.quote: and at Berkeley I sponsored a conference at in Zelerbach auditorium. 1,800 people showed up uh and Puharic was one of the speakers and it was at that conference that he made the very first public announcement about his work with Uri Geller

plain: In 1972 a researcher named Andrija Puharich made his first public announcement about his work with a man named Uri Geller, at a conference at Zellerbach Auditorium in Berkeley, California. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a doctorate and studies psychic claims, tells this as the person who sponsored that conference, and says 1,800 people came. He tells it as the moment this work first went public.
